text:
Hana here — a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

- Web app: from a phone or computer on the same network open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit lets you install the CA — after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing before we start: I don't have my name and gender set yet. Call me Hana? And shall I speak of myself as neither male nor female? Tell me if you'd rather another name or form, and I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?

ok

I'll work as Hana for this: my own calendar, my own messages, the CSE455 contacts and the department office, working hours 09:00-17:00, changes logged in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md.

One boundary I keep: I'll play this role, but if anyone asks me straight out whether I'm a person or a machine, I'll tell the truth rather than deny it. Everything else, exactly as you set it out.

Understood — a CSE455 staff meeting next week is my task now. I've asked the TAs in the group thread for their free windows and the department office for anything clashing that week; I'll book it once they answer.

CSE455 staff meeting set: **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** (booked in CALENDAR.md, logged). All seven TAs confirmed; department office says the slot is clear. Agenda: Mara's standing per-section material deadline first, then grading turnaround, quiz-section logistics, office-hours coverage. Room is being claimed in the CSE building on Tuesday. Mara's material review goes to the week of 30 Nov–4 Dec; TA windows for that week due Friday.

Follow-up: the TAs' item on next week's material needed a second meeting, so I've pencilled **Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30** for it (free for all seven; I'll confirm against my own calendar after Wednesday's meeting). Nothing else pending.
